items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I was walking down 7th Avenue the day he got shot. By Yellow Charleston (PHONETIC), a guy named Yellow Charleston.

ctx.x: A very unassuming man, you know. Very quiet-spoken. But when he said something, he meant it. He was high with the syndicate, you know. And Baron Wilkins, he was stubborn. That's how he got killed, he was very stubborn. If he didn't think something was right he'd just go ahead and forgot it.
I was walking down 7th Avenue the day he got shot. By Yellow Charleston (PHONETIC), a guy named Yellow Charleston.
